_comment: まんが「空気を 読むって なに？」の 11ページ（content/manga/kuuki_manga.json・size:"page"・speechInImage:true・縦長 1024x1536）。2026-10-20 に クイズ形式へ 作り直した（ユーザーの 指定: 選択肢を 先に クイズで 出し、次の ページで ⭕❌。席は 電車の カップル／グラスに 注ぐ／最後の からあげ「遠慮の かたまり」／年配の 女性に 席を ゆずるか は 答えの ない 問いで ⭕❌を 付けず、怒る 反応も 丸めずに 描く。「声を かける 前に ようすを 見る」）。お酌と からあげの 正解は ゲームの マナー名刺（ch5.js の「お注ぎしましょうか？」「どなたか、いかがですか？」）に そろえた。焼く 字は セリフと 一字一句 同じ（bakedText）。ふりがなは 読み辞書から bakedReadings で 出した もの。noText の 前半は RUBY_LETTERING の 逐語。参照は ヘンディと「あなた」の 設定画＋1枚目（p01）が 絵柄アンカー。脇役（カップル・先輩・部長・年配の 女性）は 見た目を 定数で 固定して 各ページに 同じ 文を 入れる。各 scene に PORTRAIT の output を 書く（書かないと 横長で 描かれて 引き伸ばされる）。
style: A full-colour Japanese manga PAGE for a language-learning lesson — one portrait page, drawn like a modern colour manga / webtoon: clean confident black linework, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette of sky blue, cream and coral, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows. Light, funny, slightly surreal gag-manga comedy — exaggerated but friendly reactions (sweat drops, little sparkles, comic anger marks), never scary. The page is divided into panels separated by white gutters, each panel with a thin black border; panels are read top to bottom, and left to right when two panels share a row. People are real human beings with natural proportions, warm faces and exactly five fingers on each hand. Keep every character's face, hair and outfit exactly as in the reference model sheets (Hendy: navy suit and navy necktie, short black hair; YOU: chin-length black bob, warm light-brown skin, bright red open zip-up jacket over a white T-shirt). Other people keep the same look on every page they appear on and do not look like Hendy or YOU. Speech balloons are white, rounded, with a tail pointing at the speaker and never covering a face. Narration captions are white rectangular boxes with a thin black border.
noText: Lettering — read this part carefully. All lettering is HORIZONTAL (left to right, yokogaki) — never vertical. Copy every text EXACTLY as given, character for character: do not translate, rephrase, shorten, or add anything. Directly above EVERY kanji, print its reading in small hiragana (furigana), centred over that kanji, clearly separated from it, at about 45% of the kanji height. Use exactly the readings listed below — never guess a reading. Hiragana, katakana, Latin letters, digits and symbols take no furigana. Letter it large and clearly legible in a plain rounded manga font. The picture contains ONLY the texts listed for this page, and no other writing at all: no extra words, no names on shirts, no logos, no watermarks, no signatures, no page numbers, no sound effects other than those listed.
negative: Never: signs, menus, noren curtains, posters, ads, bottles, boxes or screens with any writing (leave them blank or use simple pictures), extra spaces inside a word, any Japanese sentence that is not in the list for this page, vertical text, missing furigana over any kanji, furigana over hiragana or katakana, a reading different from the list, misspelled or invented characters, extra words, English translations, photo-realistic rendering, harsh shadows, extra or merged fingers, distorted or stretched faces and bodies, dark or scary mood, crying faces, threatening faces (a comic offended frown is allowed only where the page asks for it), real company logos, national flags, tiny unreadable text, panels read right-to-left.
